title: Host: tailnet admission is off under --keychain ("host access artifact or transport check failed")
body: Found on #10118 running the Mac host from a development build (scripts/desktop/dev-host.sh, same keychain keys): the host log says `tailnet admission is off: host access: Conflict/Unavailable: host access artifact or transport check failed`. tailnet.rs reads the host key with `coder_access::host::Host::new(&settings.state, ...)` (the file store) while `--keychain` keeps it in the login keychain. The phone still pairs and works over the relay/iroh; only the tailnet direct path is off. An older log (Sep 29) shows tailnet admission working. Not verified whether the installed app's host (a4688ee8b0) had the same error.
